metadata.description: Claude Code mods by Stylus Nexus

plugins.name: task-progress
plugins.description: Progress rows above the prompt for each plan the model reports, plus a row per running subagent.

plugins.name: limits-meter
plugins.description: Status line shows 5-hour and weekly usage plus running subagents; toasts at 90% and 95% of a window.

plugins.name: deploy-watch
plugins.description: Status light for Render deploys in the status line, with a toast when one starts, goes live, fails or is canceled.

plugins.name: house-rules
plugins.description: Checks goal-checklist strips, and optionally the closing status line and the conventional-commit title rule.
